ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 18:82 ratio of high-intensity (white/light gray) to low-intensity (black/dark gray) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity contiguous white region located along the superior margin of the left lobe (proximal to the distal tip). High-contrast white mottling is also visible on the distal tip of the right lobe, though partially occluded by water spray. The central fluke body and lower lobe sections consist of low-intensity black pigmentation.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central notch with an estimated interior angle of 62 degrees and a vertical bounding-box depth approximately 15% of the visible vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire visible trailing edge. Peaks and valleys exhibit amplitudes ranging from 5 to 15 pixels, with the most pronounced jagged topography appearing on the distal third of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex parabolic curves along the trailing edges of both lobes, converging at sharp distal tips. The right distal tip trajectory is partially obscured by high-velocity water spray (droplets).

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (diameter 3-8 pixels) distributed across the dark central-left and lower-right quadrants, consistent with point-source scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, near-parallel high-contrast linear streaks observed on the mid-lower section of the left lobe, oriented diagonally toward the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular serration and potential minor tissue loss along the mid-section of the left lobe trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'bordering' effect where a thin band of white pigmentation follows the contour of the trailing edge on the upper-left lobe.
